content.value_statement: Claude Router users need a quick view of routing activity and estimated savings. This skill reads the local stats file and formats the results clearly.
actual_capabilities: Reads the local Claude Router stats file when invoked.
Shows tool-aware routing and exception counts when present.
Formats estimated savings and delegation savings.
Shows recent session activity from the stats data.
limitations: Accuracy depends on the stats file contents.
Savings are estimates based on documented model cost assumptions.
Does not modify router settings or collect live traffic.

use_cases.title: Review Daily Routing Activity
use_cases.description: Check recent query volume, route mix, exceptions, and savings after a development session.

use_cases.title: Validate Router Configuration Changes
use_cases.description: Compare route distribution and savings after changing Claude Router behavior or model preferences.

use_cases.title: Summarize Usage for a Team
use_cases.description: Create a readable usage summary that explains routing outcomes and estimated cost impact.

prompt_templates.title: Show My Stats
prompt_templates.prompt: Use router-stats to show my Claude Router totals, route distribution, exceptions, and estimated savings.

prompt_templates.title: Check Today's Activity
prompt_templates.prompt: Use router-stats to summarize today's Claude Router activity and highlight total queries, savings, and route mix.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Route Distribution
prompt_templates.prompt: Use router-stats to calculate route percentages and explain what the fast, standard, deep, and orchestrated counts show.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Usage Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Use router-stats to prepare a concise report on usage, exceptions, tool-aware routing, and estimated cost savings for my team.

output_examples.output: A formatted report with total routed queries, route percentages, exception counts, and estimated total savings.

output_examples.input: How much did Claude Router save today?
output_examples.output: A daily summary that lists recent query count, estimated savings, and the route distribution for the latest session.
A short explanation of router meta-query exceptions and how they affect the reported routing totals.

best_practices: Review the output before sharing it outside your workspace.
Use the skill after meaningful router activity for useful summaries.
Treat savings as estimates, not billing records.
anti_patterns: Do not use it as a replacement for official billing data.
Do not share stats that reveal private project activity.
Do not expect results when the stats file has not been created.

faq.question: Where does the data come from?
faq.answer: It reads ~/.claude/router-stats.json when you invoke the skill.

faq.question: Does it send my data anywhere?
faq.answer: No network behavior is defined in the skill. It formats the local stats for the user.

faq.question: What happens if the stats file is missing?
faq.answer: The skill tells you that no stats are available yet.

faq.question: Can it change my router settings?
faq.answer: No. The skill only reads and formats stats data.

faq.question: How are savings calculated?
faq.answer: Savings use the assumptions documented in the skill and compare against always using Opus.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
